# ZIMR Capital Market Intelligence | Thursday, June 11, 2026

## Trump's Freedom Agenda Just Priced In—Markets Smell Confirmation

The market has decisively moved on Trump restarting Project Freedom by month-end, rocketing from 11.5% to 99% overnight on $1.8M volume. This isn't speculation—this is post-announcement positioning. Smart money bought the dip yesterday and cashed out this morning. The 87.5% move in 24 hours suggests either (a) a major news drop hit after markets closed Wednesday, or (b) institutional players got wind of an imminent statement. Watch for follow-through volume; at 99%, there's limited upside but significant tail risk if reversal narratives emerge.

Peru's Sánchez Palomino continues its death march, now at 3% after bleeding 2.6% today despite $3.7M in volume—the highest-volume loser on the board. This is liquidation, not rotation. The bid-ask spread is probably widening meaningfully here; retail is dumping, but no institutional buyers are stepping in. The persistence of volume despite directional collapse signals conviction bearishness, not uncertainty.

The Iran peace deal complex is fragmenting by deadline. The June 15 deal (5%) is trading 14% lower in probability than the June 30 version (18%), despite being just two weeks apart. This is the market pricing in near-zero chance of rapid breakthrough but leaving room for a broader summer negotiation framework. Both markets are seeing real volume ($4.3M and $1.4M respectively), suggesting this isn't retail noise—serious players are hedging geopolitical exposure ahead of mid-month catalysts.

---

## Watch List

**1. Trump Project Freedom (99%)** — Catch any reversal signals or news contradictions. A drop below 95% would be violent and signal the market overshot. Volume dries up this high; look for illiquidity spikes as a warning sign.

**2. Peru Election (3%)** — Capitulation zone. If volume persists above $3M today, it's institutional housecleaning before a hard deadline. Track if it holds at 3% or slides toward 1% (true death). Relevant for Latin America exposure traders.

**3. Iran June 15 Deal (5%)** — Most mispriced relative to June 30. If any geopolitical headlines drop (IAEA inspections, Strait of Hormuz activity, regional proxy flare-ups), this could spike or crater violently. $4.3M volume means liquidity exists for position-building.

---
